api.description: Begin 2FA setup and return a TOTP secret and QR code.

twoFactorAuth.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactorAuth.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account
twoFactorAuth.setupDescription: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app
twoFactorAuth.backupCodesDescription: Save these backup codes in a safe place. Each code can only be used once.
twoFactorAuth.confirmDisable: Are you sure you want to disable 2FA?
twoFactorAuth.disableWarning: Disabling 2FA will make your account less secure
twoFactorAuth.lowBackupCodesWarning: Running low — regenerate new backup codes soon.
twoFactorAuth.regenerateWarning: Your old backup codes will stop working immediately. Make sure to save the new ones.
twoFactorAuth.managementInstructions: Enter a current verification code or your password to regenerate backup codes or disable 2FA.

twoFactorAuth.lowBackupCodesWarning: Kodlarınız azalıyor — yakında yeni yedek kodlar oluşturun.
twoFactorAuth.regenerateWarning: Eski yedek kodlarınız hemen çalışmayı durduracak. Yenilerini kaydettiğinizden emin olun.
